body:
Wipro's second-quarter net profit fell 1.9% from a year earlier and 4.7% sequentially to Rs 3,200 crore, hurt by higher finance and marketing costs. Revenue for the three months ended September 30 rose 9.1% year-on-year and 1.1% quarter-on-quarter to Rs 24,752.7 crore, the IT services company reported on Thursday.Bengaluru-based Wipro said the business environment was weak and unchanged in the past quarter, when it reported its weakest deal wins
